title: Francis R NDE 161
content: I had just started the fifteenth seizure when everything went black. The next thing that happened I found myself walking barefoot but I had been wearing hiking boots in midwinter. The rest is very personal and private.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Epilepsy attack multiple myoclonic seizures Multiple seizures.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Learned more out of my body than in it.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I was told all is well by God the Son himself.
elements.The experience included: Presence of deceased persons | Darkness | A landscape or city
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes My grandmother but I did not speak to her.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I have a telepathic connection with people in another universe not our own.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: No I didn't want to come back I wanted to stay.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No I didn't want to come back I wanted to stay. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I do not care to be here at all.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I do not care to be here at all. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I was ordered to return and I didn't want to! I wanted to stay, for the first time in my life, I was happy. I haven't been so since and nothing has changed this fact.
